newsitem.title: USA: Universal to buy Allied Outdoor billboard assets.
newsitem.headline: Universal to buy Allied Outdoor billboard assets.

text.p: Universal Outdoor Holdings Inc. said Friday its Universal Outdoor Inc. unit agreed in principle to acquire the outdoor advertising business of Allied Outdoor Advertising Inc. in the New York City metropolitan area for about $51.2 million.

The deal is part of a trend toward consolidation in the billboard advertising industry. On Thursday, Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co. agreed to sell its billboard and mall advertising division to Outdoor Systems Inc. for $1 billion.
The Universal transaction is subject to a definitive agreement and regulatory approvals, it said.
Allied owns and operates about 90 outdoor advertising sign display faces in New York City and New Jersey.
Universal, based in Chicago, owns and operates about 31,000 outdoor advertising displays in the East, Southeast and Midwest.
